title: Additions to taxes for noncompliance or evasion; interest on underpayments and overpayments.
bodyText: The provisions of section 231-39 shall apply to taxes under this article.
bodyHtml: [§431:7-202.5]  Additions to taxes for noncompliance or evasion; interest on underpayments and overpayments.  The provisions of section 231-39 shall apply to taxes under this article. [L 1992, c 236, §2]
